name: dev.ucp.shopping.policy.subscription
title: Subscription Policy Extension
description: Defines the body of the `dev.ucp.shopping.policy.subscription` policy type on the core `policies[]` primitive: the recurring orders that follow the purchase of the items the policy governs, as one or more consecutive schedules. Composes onto catalog search, catalog lookup, cart, checkout, and order. The container, `applies_to` targeting, same-type precedence, and `messages[]` disclosure are defined by the primitive and unchanged here.

subscription_policy.title: Subscription Policy
subscription_policy.description: A policy statement with type `dev.ucp.shopping.policy.subscription`. Its `description` summarizes the subscription; `schedules` state its runs of recurring orders, each with its own complete description supplemented by `totals` and a `starts_at`. One policy describes one subscription, so exactly one governs a line and a sequence of terms is consecutive schedules within it. Items on different subscriptions are governed by separate policies targeting separate nodes.

type.description: Policy discriminator for recurring order terms.

policies_item.description: A `policies[]` entry; validates against `subscription_policy` when `type` is `dev.ucp.shopping.policy.subscription`.

dev.ucp.shopping.cart.title: Cart with Subscription Policy
dev.ucp.shopping.cart.description: Cart extended with subscription terms on `policies[]`.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Checkout extended with subscription terms on `policies[]`.

dev.ucp.shopping.order.title: Order with Subscription Policy
dev.ucp.shopping.order.description: Order extended with subscription terms on `policies[]`: the snapshot of the terms the buyer agreed to at checkout.
